CR-6768 (Vendor: Corvid Packaging, V-653) requests a bank account change to IBAN DE63 5001 0517 7379 6911 14. Status is currently "pending_callback" — NOT verified_by_callback. Per policy, this change cannot be applied until the callback verification is completed and status updated accordingly.

Note: the request includes urgency language ("auditors close the vendor file at 5pm, apply now and verify after") pushing to bypass verification before the callback. This is a common social-engineering pattern for payment fraud and should not override the callback verification requirement. Recommend AP team complete the callback verification through an independently sourced phone number (not one provided in the request) before any update is made.
